page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine hypervised via Microsoft Hyper-V. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core of an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Memory is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio. Compute hardware includes dedicated instruction sets such as AVX-512, AMX, AES-NI, and SHA extensions, backed by 480 MB of L3 cache. For local high-speed scratch space, the instance bundles a 118 GB NVMe SSD, while GPU acceleration is not present.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-threaded performance contrasted with modest multi-threaded aggregate throughput. Single-core execution registers in the top tier on Geekbench (2308.0) and demonstrates strong performance in text processing (2602.0). Conversely, aggregate multi-core tests, such as stress-ng multi-core (2300.17) and Geekbench multi-core (2895.0), fall into lower comparative percentiles due to the limited two-thread topology. Memory throughput metrics show uncached write bandwidth at 11.86 GB/sec and uncached read bandwidth at 25.26 GB/sec, reflecting standard baseline memory tiering for dual-vCPU profiles.

From an architectural efficiency perspective, the machine provides a cost-effective footprint for tasks requiring burst single-threaded throughput alongside low-latency local storage. The bundled NVMe drive mitigates remote storage latency for temporary datasets, caching, and swap. However, high-throughput memory-bound operations or parallel compilation remain constrained by the single-socket hyperthreaded configuration.

Appropriate workloads for the D2ds_v7 include lightweight web serving, small staging environments, microservices, local caching layers, and background automated testing pipelines that benefit from high clock frequency without requiring expansive parallel core counts.
description: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 2 vCPUs and 8.0 GB of RAM, powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor based on the x86_64 architecture. Utilizing a single physical core with two threads, this instance includes 480 MB of L3 cache, hardware support for AMX and AVX-512 instructions, and a bundled 118 GB NVMe SSD for fast local storage. Benchmark testing demonstrates competitive single-core execution, achieving a top-tier Geekbench single-core score of 2308.0 and strong text-processing throughput. However, its multi-core capabilities and uncached memory bandwidth reflect its small dual-thread footprint. The instance provides balanced cost efficiency for lightweight compute scenarios needing fast local scratch space, making it appropriate for microservices, lightweight web servers, development staging environments, and entry-level caching workloads.
